security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; media-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Speech to text on this computer
bundle.longDescription: pktito pulls the audio out of a media file with the libraries your OS already has and transcribes it on this computer with pktito, a C11 port of NVIDIA's Parakeet-TDT models.
bundle.copyright: pktito authors, MIT license. Models: NVIDIA, CC-BY-4.0.
